fato_historico: 2021: An SUV plows through a Christmas parade in Waukesha, Wisconsin, killing six and injuring 62.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may feel an urge to wrap your loved ones in a warm embrace. Life can be fragile, like the sudden shift of a winter breeze, so prioritize creating sanctuary. Perhaps today is the perfect time to foster community spirit and light a candle for healing, remembering that small acts of kindness illuminate the darkest paths.
frase_do_dia: Where there is love, there is always a way to heal and grow.
significado_numero: Represents the master builder of dreams and deep emotional connection.
conselho: Consider reaching out to a neighbor or friend who might need extra comfort today.
